search_surface: Homebrew formula-name index for C PDF library discovery; targeted official PDFio, PDFium, Poppler GLib, qpdf C API, MuPDF and Ghostscript documentation. Formula-name search is not a complete C registry. Targeted unpdf official C ABI documentation and crates.io release were inspected outside the bounded Homebrew name hits.

brew search --formula pdfio; local Homebrew formula-name index, fuzzy order, not usage-ranked
